# Ecomm Wizards

> Ecomm Wizards is a Shopify Plus agency that designs, builds, migrates, and optimizes high-converting Shopify and Shopify Plus stores. 700+ stores built, $900M+ in client revenue, 8+ years of experience.

Key facts:
- Founded in 2017; 8+ years building on Shopify and Shopify Plus.
- Shopify Plus Partner (since 2021), Klaviyo Partner, and Meta Business Partner.
- 700+ Shopify stores launched and $900M+ in client revenue generated.
- Services span store development, Shopify Plus, replatforming/migration, conversion rate optimization (CRO), SEO, custom app development, theme development, B2B, and POS.
- Work includes brands such as Everlast, Candy Kittens, Happy Mammoth, 111SKIN, Ronaldo Jewelry, Twillory, VITHIT, Saddleback, and Wild.

## Services
- [Shopify Store Development](https://ecommwizards.com/services/shopify-store-development): Custom Shopify store design and build for DTC and growth-stage brands.
- [Shopify Plus Development](https://ecommwizards.com/services/shopify-plus-development): Enterprise Shopify Plus builds with custom theme, checkout, and integrations.
- [Shopify Migration](https://ecommwizards.com/services/migration): Replatforming to Shopify from Magento, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, and others, with SEO-safe redirects.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization](https://ecommwizards.com/services/shopify-cro-agency): Data-driven CRO programs with A/B testing to lift conversion rate and revenue.
- [Cart Gamification](https://ecommwizards.com/services/shopify-cart-gamification): Increase average order value with free-shipping progress bars, tiered rewards, and gift-with-purchase built into the Shopify cart.
- [Shopify SEO](https://ecommwizards.com/services/shopify-seo-agency): Technical and content SEO for Shopify stores to grow organic traffic.
- [Shopify App Development](https://ecommwizards.com/services/shopify-app-development): Custom public and private Shopify apps, including checkout and fulfillment integrations.
- [Theme Development](https://ecommwizards.com/services/shopify-theme-development): Custom Shopify Online Store 2.0 themes built for performance and merchandiser control.
- [B2B Store Setup](https://ecommwizards.com/services/shopify-b2b-store-setup): Shopify Plus B2B stores with company accounts, tiered pricing, and trade portals.
- [POS Setup](https://ecommwizards.com/services/shopify-pos-setup): Shopify POS configuration to unify in-store and online retail.

## Case Studies
- [Saddleback — Shopify Plus B2B](https://ecommwizards.com/case-studies/saddleback-shopify-plus-b2b): +881% B2B sales growth and +704% traffic after a Shopify Plus B2B rebuild.
- [Candy Kittens — Food & Beverage CRO](https://ecommwizards.com/case-studies/candy-kittens-shopify-food-beverage-cro): +182% conversion rate and +$8.1M new annual revenue.
- [Ronaldo Jewelry — Shopify Plus Redesign](https://ecommwizards.com/case-studies/ronaldo-jewelry-shopify-plus-redesign): +250% total sales and +120% conversion rate.

- [Everlast — Sports Redesign](https://ecommwizards.com/case-studies/everlast-shopify-plus-sports-redesign): +152% conversion rate and +48% total orders.
- [Happy Mammoth — Subscriptions CRO](https://ecommwizards.com/case-studies/happy-mammoth-shopify-subscriptions-cro): +134% subscription revenue and +61% conversion rate.
- [Twillory — Shopify CRO](https://ecommwizards.com/case-studies/twillory-shopify-cro): $5.4M new annual revenue from a systematic CRO and A/B testing program.
- [111SKIN — CRO & Redesign](https://ecommwizards.com/case-studies/111skin-shopify-cro-redesign): +46% conversion rate and +21% revenue for a luxury skincare brand.
- [Wild — Subscriptions](https://ecommwizards.com/case-studies/wild-shopify-plus-subscriptions): Scaled to 80,000+ active monthly subscribers with +218% subscription revenue.
- [teelaunch — Print-on-Demand App](https://ecommwizards.com/case-studies/teelaunch-print-on-demand): Built a print-on-demand fulfillment app on the Shopify App Store, reaching 50,000+ merchants.
- [Chilly's — Creative Strategy](https://ecommwizards.com/case-studies/chillys-creative-strategy): Performance creative for paid social lifted revenue 33% and ROAS 60% while cutting ad spend 22%.
- [Prose — Creative Strategy](https://ecommwizards.com/case-studies/prose-creative-strategy): A micro-influencer creative engine for paid social lifted return on ad spend 53% and cut cost per acquisition 28%.
- [Nurture Life — Creative Strategy](https://ecommwizards.com/case-studies/nurture-life-creative-strategy): Parent and kid UGC for paid social lifted conversions 130% and conversion rate 232% while cutting cost per acquisition 14%.
- [All Case Studies](https://ecommwizards.com/case-studies): Full portfolio of 30+ Shopify store, app, email marketing, and creative strategy projects.
